title: Kernel of the explicit Veronese fraction map
statement: For any scheme X [def-pc-scheme], invertible module L [def-sc-invertible-module], natural number d and s in degree d of its section ring [def-sc-invertible-section-ring], let g be the explicit additive map of [def-sc-section-ring-veronese-fraction-map] and let R be the fraction-relation submodule of [def-sc-section-fraction-presentation] for M=L tensorPow d, F=O_X and sigma=s_d. Then R, regarded as an additive subgroup of the numerator direct sum, equals ker(g). This states equality of subgroups for a fixed constructed map, without a generator formula for any unspecified equivalence.

source.place: Equation module-invert-s (Tag 0B5L), Lemma 01PW(2), and the Veronese localization in the proof of Lemma 01Q1

proof.text: Apply the numerator transition identity [lem-sc-section-ring-veronese-numerator-transition]. The ambient localization equality criterion shows that each transition difference maps to zero, as does every scalar multiple, since transition maps are linear. Use Submodule.span_induction with predicate that every scalar multiple maps to zero: addition uses additivity of the fraction map, and the scalar step uses multiplication of scalars. Specializing to scalar one proves the relation submodule lies in the additive kernel. No span/additive-closure comparison theorem or scalar-to-section-ring coherence lemma is needed.

Direct-sum induction reduces each finite sum modulo the relation span to one generator. For two generators use common degree n+m, transitioning by m and n respectively, and add their numerators. If this generator maps to zero, the ambient localization supplies a power s^b annihilating its ring numerator. The numerator transition identity and injectivity of the graded injection and the inverse numerator isomorphism show its transition is zero. The corresponding transition difference is the original generator, proving the reverse kernel inclusion.

theorem sectionRingVeroneseFractionMap_kernel
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (d : ℕ) (s : sectionRingGrade L d) :
    (sectionFractionRelations (L.tensorPow d) (𝟙_ X.Modules) (s.val d)).toAddSubgroup =
      (sectionRingVeroneseFractionMap X L d s).ker
